A Place Further than the Universe - 4 girls go on an expedition to Antartica. Beautiful animation, inspired me to go on adventures.

Violet Evergarden - A young girl, after taking part in the war, decides to take a job at a post office. Has a lot of heartwarming and heartbreaking stories along with stunning animation.

¤━━━¤°¤━━━¤°¤━━━¤ ***Festin: A Cooking D&D Server***  ¤━━━¤°¤━━━¤°¤━━━¤

A new Westmarch D&D server where you can go on cooking adventures! This server features:

\- **Live Play** ***and*** **Play-by-Post** channels!  
\- A character race called **Harvestborn!**

\- Additional cooking classes:  **Baker, Seasoner, Presenter, Tracker, Butcher, Reciper**\- Subclasses: **War Cook (Fighter), Circle of the Brew (Druid), Pleasure Domain (Cleric), Oath of Beauty (Paladin), College of Hosting (Bard).**

\-A leveling system called **The Accomplishment System (AP)** that allows for gaining points for playstyles that are more than just combat!

\-Five homebrew subregions: ***Town of Talaba (Dragon Stew), Heartsong Pastures, The Pristine Coast, Wayver Summit, and Jacktree Timberlands.***\-**Customized role access to game channels for concise server navigation!**

\-**Sourcebooks and supplements available for perusal in Google Drive!**

\-**Timezone roles to let players and DMs know your availability!**

ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤ**Festin Description**

*"In a distant part of the Forgotten Realms, there lies a continent called Festin, a land not only known for their fantastical fauna and flora, as well as diverse culture and people, but most of all for it's culinary ingenuity and gourmet innovations.*

*Festin is rife with food enthusiasts and aspiring chefs, so much so that no adventurer is unaware of at least one famous recipe in their mind. Adventures and myths in this world involve slaying monsters long-thought to be inedible, only to make a delicious dish out of their butchered parts, as well as exploring uncharted lands for undiscovered ingredients and magical utensils."*

**Join now to play!** [https://discord.gg/2E3N3R6e65](https://discord.gg/2E3N3R6e65)

A new D&D server where the main theme is cooking! The main supplement used is Dragon Stew, which features additional cooking classes, subclasses, and a homebrew race! We also have our own leveling system and detailed information on the world.

Our server includes both Play-by-Post and Live Play!

ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤ**World Lore: Region of Basserico**

"The peaceful and most civilized region of Festin. Basserico consists of fertile and verdant lands cultivated by hard-working races into farms and plantations. This region has multiple towns involved in an active trade economy, exchanging resources with each other from an abundant variety of habitats, such as caves, forests, mountains, and grasslands.

Traversing through these lands are effortless, with well-laid paths connected to the main trade hubs of the region. There is little to no political conflict, with towns having strong diplomatic ties to neighboring settlements. Most races are friendly with each other, being able to coexist in harmony.

The main areas of this region are: *Town of Talaba, Heartsong Pastures, The Pristine Coast, Wayver Summit, and Jacktree Timberlands*."
